summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Buf and Protobuf.

values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/buf-purifier'
buf-purifier lock
buf build
buf lint
buf generate
values.language_tooling_setup: Start `buf lsp serve` through the supplied wrapper after `buf-purifier prefetch`. It reads the prepared locked modules and their source paths. Missing dependency-cache entries fail before registry fetching; private writable caches use `XDG_CACHE_HOME`.
